A1.justification: Local commands to read the PDF skill and extract v1.pdf and v2.pdf repeatedly stalled without returning content. Neither PDF, including its appendices, could be inspected, so identity and material completeness could not be verified. This is an access limitation, not evidence of missing document content.

before.justification: No readable content was obtained from v1.pdf, so the presence of original empirical results could not be assessed.

after.justification: No readable content was obtained from v2.pdf, so the presence of original empirical results could not be assessed.

M1.justification: The method descriptions and equations were unavailable, preventing assessment of changes to the proposed procedure or model.

E1.justification: Dataset and task descriptions could not be inspected, so training and evaluation coverage could not be compared.

E2.justification: The reported comparisons were unavailable, preventing verification of baseline membership in corresponding experiments.

E3.justification: Experimental protocols and settings could not be read, preventing distinction between revised settings and newly disclosed details.

E4.justification: Main-text and appendix analyses were unavailable, so changes to ablations, robustness tests, and supplementary analyses could not be determined.

E5.justification: Run counts, seed information, and statistical reporting could not be inspected in either version.

E6.justification: Result tables, figures, and passages were unavailable, preventing verification of numerical or qualitative changes under matched conditions.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, derivations, and proofs could not be inspected, including any appendix material.

C1.justification: The abstracts, introductions, and conclusions were unavailable, so changes to core claims and contributions could not be assessed.

C2.justification: Interpretations, mechanism explanations, and limitations could not be read or compared.

D1.justification: Implementation details and reproducibility disclosures were unavailable, preventing assessment of additions, removals, or revisions.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions and references could not be inspected, so citation and research-positioning changes remain unresolved.

P1.justification: Neither document's text or structure could be inspected, preventing assessment of rewriting, terminology changes, or reorganization.

P2.justification: No page renders or readable visual material were obtained, so figures, tables, captions, and layout could not be compared.

improvement.justification: The local reading failure left both PDFs and their appendices uninspected. Without before-and-after document evidence, the benefits, harms, and overall quality implications of the revision cannot be assessed reliably.
